title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode3 The Future Star and Wonderhoy!

meta.Episode: Episode3 — The Future Star and Wonderhoy!

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay so... Give me a moment to make sense of everything you just said. You perform at this stage?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And I didn't pass the audition, but you invited me to join you here as a special favor?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Meaning... I'm going to be working here at this dilapidated stage?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's not dilapidated! It has a stylish color scheme!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You do realize it's not paint, it's rust, right?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But why has it been left in this state to begin with? All the other park attractions are either new or renovated and I heard they were building a brand new stage.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: The original plan was to renovate the entire park, demolishing old stages and building new ones.

rows.Speaker: Mascot
rows.Line: But right now, the construction of a new stage here has been put on hold.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Why?
And if it's going to be demolished, does it mean it's closed for now?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
No, we're still doing shows!
Today was Fish World Show! I played the sunfish!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There was no audience, though!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's the point then?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But with you here, we're going to draw in crowds again! I feel it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sigh... Now listen. I have ambitions, you know!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
When I was little, I was taken to see a musical.
The lead was an amazing actor.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I was bedazzled! My heart was stolen!
I had witnessed a true star!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
After that event, my mind was made up.
I decided to become an illustrious star myself!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But for that to happen, I must make my debut as part of a major troupe, performing in front of a great audience!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You know, there's a special trap door on the stage you can spring out of! Do you want to try it out?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Were you even listening to anything I said?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I heard lots about you at the audition!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You promised incredible shows!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That really spoke to me!
I just KNEW you were the person I needed to make this stage great again!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, so you've been smitten with me ever since the audition? Hehe, I see. So that's how it is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What are you writing in your notepad?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I'll do this for you as a special favor.
Tsu...ka...sa... Ten...ma. There, that turned out nicely.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow! Your writing's so cool! Is this for me? Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha. Keep it safe. One day this autograph will be worth a fortune! Well then, farewell, my strange fan.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Gwah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Don't go! Let's do shows together! I promise it'll be fun!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let go of my collar, I can't...breathe!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Pleeease? Don't leave! You promised great shows!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh... I can't...speak... Uh... Ugh... *wheeze*!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You prooomiiisseddd!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If you're so keen on being in shows, just join a theater troupe!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then you can perform on proper stages, not forsaken ruins like this one!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No! It has to be here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I made a promise! I said I'd fill all audience seats!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why'd you do that...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to perform here at this stage and make lots of people smile! So, please help me... Oh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why did you stop all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The projector switched on all by itself... Is it broken?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hello everyone♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <An exciting show is about to begin♪ Are you ready?>
bgm_area00004

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
That's a Hatsune Miku hologram.
I didn't know she was this park's mascot character.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She isn't. Our mascot is Phenny the Phoenix Penguin.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Then what is this?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<It seems everyone's ready to start!
Allow me to take you on a fun-filled adventure in a wonderful SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: She disappeared! What was that about?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How would I know?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sigh... This day's just been one thing after another. I don't have the energy for this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No offense, but I'm going to phone HR and officially resign.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whaaat?! No, please, listen—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I've listened enough! Where did I save that number...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What's this? It says “Untitled”?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What's that? A song?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, give me some space!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I wanna hear it♪
Tap!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Argh! Hands off my phone! What if it's one of those scams where they lock your phone with a virus if you don't pay up or something?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What the heck? My phone's flashing!
Don't tell me it really was some scammer's virus?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Eek! I can't see!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What was that... Huh, what's this? Where am I?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How did I get here? I can't see Emu anywhere either.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh... I know you're there. Show yourself!
It's Mikudayo☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Aaaaaaaargh! Wh-What on earth?!
